name: Ab Wheel Rollout Single-Leg Extension
description: An ab wheel rollout with one leg extended straight while the other knee stays on the ground. The asymmetrical leg position creates a rotational challenge in addition to the standard anti-extension demand. This bridges the gap between kneeling and standing rollouts.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Ab Wheel Rollout Single-Leg Extension in proper position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare body and equipment for Ab Wheel Rollout Single-Leg Extension.
steps: Step 1: Kneel with one knee down and opposite leg extended back.
Step 2: Roll ab wheel forward while keeping extended leg straight.
Step 3: Roll to near-full extension maintaining rigid body.
Step 4: Pull back to start using core.
execution.breathing_instructions: Breathe steadily; never hold breath during static holds.
safety_considerations: Build prerequisite strength before attempting advanced variations.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full range of motion with control at all times.
coaching_cues: More difficult than bilateral kneeling version
